style.name: 白夜冷调
style.referenceRole: 已验收的风格参考，仅匹配半写实笔触、冷青灰色板、反光逻辑、颗粒和构图安全区，不复制具体场景或人物。
style.prefix: Cinematic semi-realistic anime visual-novel illustration, painterly realism, mature Japanese mystery noir, cold desaturated blue-grey palette (#1e2a36, #6c7f8f, #dfe6ea), pale sunless light, restrained contrast, subtle film grain, Showa-to-early-Heisei Japan, original character and object design,
style.suffix: , high-detail game art, no readable text, no logo, no UI, no border, no signature, no watermark
style.negative: warm cozy sunlight, cheerful saturated colors, cyberpunk neon, modern smartphones, modern vehicles, recognizable actors, front-facing portrait, duplicated people or reflections, glossy 3D render, gore

composition.background: 16:9；底部约 25% 保持低信息密度，供对话 UI 覆盖。
composition.cg: 16:9；关键人物、证据和叙事动作不得落入底部约 25% 安全区。
composition.icon: 3:4；单物件居中、完整可辨，深蓝灰无文字背景。

agePolicy.ch01_ch02: 1973–74：亮司与雪穗均为 11 岁。只允许远景、环境镜头、背影或剪纸侧写；不得特写未成年人面部，不得与案发、暴力、武器、伤害或威胁成人同构图。
agePolicy.ch03: 1976–79：中学生阶段。仅背影、剪影或无脸倒影，服装和身形符合青少年，不成人化、不性感化。
agePolicy.ch06_ch09: 1988–92：成年人，约 25–30 岁；仍不出正脸，亮司与雪穗不正面同框。

style.generationMode: OpenAI built-in image generation；逐张生成并人工验收，风格参考为上述 3 张 LookDev。

items.prompt: Wide 16:9 empty investigative environment: an abandoned unfinished commercial building in Osaka on a steady rainy night in 1973; raw concrete columns, exposed stairs, rusted ventilation grilles, puddles and one weak period streetlamp; period utility poles and distant compact cars; lower quarter dark and low-detail; no people, body, weapon, blood, violence, or readable signage.

Wide 16:9 Osaka public library reading room in 1973: card catalogue, worn books, wood tables, rain-frosted windows; one very small eleven-year-old schoolboy far in the upper middle, fully clothed and seen only from behind making a simple paper cutout; lower quarter low-detail; calm environment only, no face close-up, crime, weapon, violence, injury, threatening adult, or distress.

Wide 16:9 empty modest Osaka row-house room in 1974 after investigators have left: an old unlit gas heater, enamel kettle, tatami, rain-streaked window and cold dawn light; no people, body, injury, active gas, fire, violence, or sensational detail; lower quarter uncluttered.
